scope: Source inspection only; no compilation, model execution, new portability proof or finished export.
identityPolicy: Working-tree per-file hashes identify inspected bytes. Git HEAD records ancestry only. Historical receipts retain original paths and hashes.
selectedSurface: Fresh configurable RPB-v22 over v20; shared streaming TRAIN scaler; distinct v22 inference and typed fixed-AdamW training state.
closureMethod: Recursively resolve literal quoted includes relative to each source and then declared include roots. Include conditional branches textually; no compiler preprocessing. Angle includes are external dependencies. Read-only file inspection.
externalRequirements: LibTorch 2.6.0+cu124 with CUDA 12.4; actual CUDA F32 model and F64 relation arithmetic
Inherited SDK remains /opt/cuwacunu_embedding/libtorch; binaries and their upstream licenses are separate from source

deliveryPlan.status: Proposed; this inventory is not a release manifest
deliveryPlan.mapping: Preserve selected closure/config/license origin bytes at sources/<repository-relative-path>; proposedPackageDestination is null for audit-only context. A release adds new runner/API/recipe/tests and curated documentation with its own exact manifest and destination hashes.
deliveryPlan.consumer: Import through consumer managed build; record exact source and destination hashes and adaptations. No runtime sibling checkout. Raw numerical artifacts are separate from authenticated ModelRef, publication, selection, capture and downstream-parent admission.
